sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [F]O little town of [Gm]Bethlehem,
How [F]still we [C7]see thee [F]lie!
Above [F7]thy [D]deep [D7]and [Gm]dreamless sleep
[F]The silent [Am]stars [C7]go [F]by.
[F]Yet in thy [C7]dark [E7]streets [A]shineth
The [Dm]everlas[Gm]ting [A]Light;
[F]The hopes and fears of [Gm]all the years
Are [F]met in [Csus]thee [C7]to[F]night.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [F]For Christ is born of [Gm]Mary, and gathered all above,
[F]While mortals sleep, [C7]the angels keep their [F]watch of wondering love.
[F7]O morning [D]stars together, [D7]proclaim the [Gm]holy birth,
[F]And praises sing [Am]to God the [C7]King, and peace [F]to men on earth!

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [F]How silently, how silently, [Gm]the wondrous Gift is giv'n;
[F]So God imparts [C7]to human hearts the [F]blessings of His heav'n.
[F7]No ear may [D]hear His coming, [D7]but in this [Gm]world of sin,
[F]Where meek souls [Am]will receive Him [C7]still, the dear [F]Christ enters in.

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: [F]O holy Child of Bethlehem, [Gm]descend to us, we pray;
[F]Cast out our sin, [C7]and enter in, be [F]born in us today.
[F7]We hear [D]the Christmas angels [D7]the great [Gm]glad tidings tell;
[F]O come [Am]to us, abide [C7]with us, [F]our Lord Emmanuel!
